name: Holy Basil Seed
summary: Holy Basil Seed carries a Grade C rating — limited evidence. Recorded activity centres on metabolic regulation and glucose metabolism, which describes mechanism rather than demonstrated benefit. Noted cautions include pregnancy/breastfeeding without clinician supervision and known allergy to the plant/family.
description: Holy Basil Seed botanical profile with evidence, safety, and practical fit.
safetyNotes: REPRODUCTIVE SAFETY GAP: Holy basil species has animal data suggesting reproductive/implantation effects at high doses, but these data do not directly establish risks for seed preparations or humans. Avoid medicinal holy basil seed use when pregnant, trying to conceive or breastfeeding until preparation-specific safety is established. Review glucose-lowering medications with a clinician.
contraindications: Pregnancy or conception planning: avoid medicinal seed products because preparation-specific safety is unestablished
interactions: Potential interaction concern with antidiabetic medicines
use clinician review for high-dose extracts or chronic use.

sources.note: Species-level animal reproductive findings; direct seed-specific human evidence absent.
